Terminal equality/order kernels from October 2026 co:forms and pf:kernel, with arbitrary finite total mass m, nonatomic time measures, a free label action for the full sign kernel and a bijective label action for the lag-one truncated sign kernel.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 207 (The ℓ¹-Bass conjecture for all discrete groups.; papers: The ℓ¹-Bass Conjecture for Discrete Groups; The Bass trace conjecture and the characteristic-zero Kaplansky idempotent conjecture; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/207.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

For finite nonatomic positive measures mu,nu on R of combined mass M, each sign or strict-order kernel L2(nu)->L2(mu) admits, for every integer N>=1, a rank-at-most-N approximation with operator error at most M/(2N), and has norm at most sqrt(mu(R)nu(R)).

If countably many mutually orthogonal source and target block pairs have combined masses b_i with sum at most 2m, norm at most b_i/2 and rank-N approximation error at most b_i/(2N), their sum has, for every x>0, a finite-rank approximation with error at most x and rank at most 2m/x. Three such contributions have error at most x and rank at most 18m/x.

Every finite-dimensional orthogonal compression of the actual full-sign twisted equality kernel for a free label action has singular values s_nu<=4m/nu. For the actual sign(s)1_{|s|<1} twisted equality kernel of any bijection, every such compression satisfies s_nu<=36m/nu, including twist orders one and two. The bounds hold for every nu>=1, all finite total masses m, zero masses, arbitrary support and compression rank.

For either terminal kernel, any even k vectors X_i, W>=0 and Q_ij=<X_i,T X_j> satisfy |Pf(W Q)| <= (36m W)^(k/2) (product_i ||X_i||)/sqrt(k!). If ||X_i||<=a l_i/sqrt(beta/n), this is at most (sqrt(36 e m) a sqrt(W)/sqrt(beta))^k (n/k)^(k/2) product_i l_i. Rank-deficient spans give zero.

In every finite matrix dimension, a weighted kernel constant on pairs of bins factors through the bin index set, so its real matrix rank is at most the number of bins. For any label permutation, the lag-one equality kernel is skew; for the identity it is zero, and for an involution it is sign(v-u) times (1_{y=z}-1_{y=sigma z}).

October thm:main: for every discrete group and every matrix idempotent over l1(G), the Hattori-Stallings trace is supported on finitely many conjugacy classes of finite-order elements. This is the manuscript claim, not a result of the present bounded audit.

October ch:summary and ch:terminal provide smooth equivariant spatial channels with the stated mass, concentration and transfer-derivative estimates uniformly over the input support. Open outside the bounded terminal-operator audit.

October co:connection provides a compatible connection, contraction at least 1/10, coefficient control and Fisher bounds for all allowed tuples and parameters. Open outside the bounded terminal-operator audit.

October pf:bound: the full normalized curvature has averaged Pfaffian at most C_R (C S^(3/2) R^(-1/10))^n product_i l_i uniformly in dimension, tuple and allowed twist. Raw occupancy, intermediate stages and assembly remain open.

October red:reduction, cy:weights-lemma and cy:trace-identity permit exponential-moment reduction, cyclic curvature detection and summation of the averaged estimate uniformly in the conjugacy class. Open outside the bounded terminal-operator audit.

October pf:bound: the full normalized curvature has averaged Pfaffian at most C_R (C S^(3/2) R^(-1/10))^n product_i l_i uniformly in dimension, tuple and allowed twist. Raw occupancy, intermediate stages and assembly remain open.

claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/-!
# Bounded terminal-order kernel algebra

Finite weighted bin kernels factor through the bin index set. The exact lag-one
twisted equality kernel is skew, vanishes for the identity permutation, and has
an order-sign factorization for involutions.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace TerminalOrderKernel

universe uI uJ uB uL

section Bins

variable {I : Type uI} {J : Type uJ} {B : Type uB}
variable [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]

/-- An arbitrary real bin kernel with independent row and column weights. -/
def weightedBinMatrix (r : I → B) (c : J → B) (w : I → ℝ) (z : J → ℝ)
    (K : Matrix B B ℝ) : Matrix I J ℝ :=
  fun i j => w i * K (r i) (c j) * z j

/-- Weighted incidence matrix from rows to bins. -/
def rowLift (r : I → B) (w : I → ℝ) : Matrix I B ℝ :=
  fun i b => if r i = b then w i else 0

/-- Weighted incidence matrix from bins to columns. -/
def columnLift (c : J → B) (z : J → ℝ) : Matrix B J ℝ :=
  fun b j => if b = c j then z j else 0

omit [Fintype I] [Fintype J] in
theorem weightedBinMatrix_factorization (r : I → B) (c : J → B)
    (w : I → ℝ) (z : J → ℝ) (K : Matrix B B ℝ) :
    weightedBinMatrix r c w z K = rowLift r w * K * columnLift c z := by
  funext i j
  simp [weightedBinMatrix, rowLift, columnLift, Matrix.mul_apply, ite_mul, mul_ite]

omit [Fintype I] in
theorem weightedBinMatrix_rank_le_kernel (r : I → B) (c : J → B)
    (w : I → ℝ) (z : J → ℝ) (K : Matrix B B ℝ) :
    (weightedBinMatrix r c w z K).rank ≤ K.rank := by
  rw [weightedBinMatrix_factorization]
  exact (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _)

omit [Fintype I] in
theorem weightedBinMatrix_rank_le_bins (r : I → B) (c : J → B)
    (w : I → ℝ) (z : J → ℝ) (K : Matrix B B ℝ) :
    (weightedBinMatrix r c w z K).rank ≤ Fintype.card B := by
  exact (weightedBinMatrix_rank_le_kernel r c w z K).trans
    (Matrix.rank_le_card_width K)

end Bins

section TimeKernel

variable {L : Type uL} [DecidableEq L]

def ltIndicator (u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if u < v then 1 else 0

/-- The sign of `v - u`, with zero at equal times. -/
def osign (u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if u < v then 1 else if v < u then -1 else 0

def eqIndicator (y z : L) : ℝ :=
  if y = z then 1 else 0

theorem osign_eq_indicator_sub (u v : ℝ) :
    osign u v = ltIndicator u v - ltIndicator v u := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy u v with h | h | h
  · simp [osign, ltIndicator, h, lt_asymm h]
  · subst v
    simp [osign, ltIndicator]
  · simp [osign, ltIndicator, h, lt_asymm h]

theorem osign_swap (u v : ℝ) :
    osign u v = -osign v u := by
  rw [osign_eq_indicator_sub, osign_eq_indicator_sub]
  ring

theorem eqIndicator_comm (y z : L) :
    eqIndicator y z = eqIndicator z y := by
  simp only [eqIndicator, eq_comm]

theorem eqIndicator_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm L) (y z : L) :
    eqIndicator y (σ z) = eqIndicator z (σ.symm y) := by
  have h : (y = σ z) ↔ (z = σ.symm y) :=
    eq_comm.trans σ.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply
  simp only [eqIndicator, h]

theorem eqIndicator_apply_symm (σ : Equiv.Perm L) (y z : L) :
    eqIndicator y (σ.symm z) = eqIndicator z (σ y) := by
  simpa only [Equiv.symm_symm] using eqIndicator_apply σ.symm y z

/-- The exact zero, plus-one, minus-one shift decomposition. -/
def twistedEqualityKernel (σ : Equiv.Perm L) (u : ℝ) (y : L)
    (v : ℝ) (z : L) : ℝ :=
  osign u v * eqIndicator y z
    + ltIndicator v u * eqIndicator y (σ z)
    - ltIndicator u v * eqIndicator y (σ.symm z)

theorem twistedEqualityKernel_skew (σ : Equiv.Perm L)
    (u : ℝ) (y : L) (v : ℝ) (z : L) :
    twistedEqualityKernel σ u y v z = -twistedEqualityKernel σ v z u y := by
  unfold twistedEqualityKernel
  rw [osign_swap v u, eqIndicator_comm z y,
    eqIndicator_apply σ z y, eqIndicator_apply_symm σ z y]
  ring

theorem twistedEqualityKernel_identity (u : ℝ) (y : L) (v : ℝ) (z : L) :
    twistedEqualityKernel (Equiv.refl L) u y v z = 0 := by
  simp only [twistedEqualityKernel, Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.refl_apply,
    osign_eq_indicator_sub]
  ring

theorem twistedEqualityKernel_same_time (σ : Equiv.Perm L) (u : ℝ) (y z : L) :
    twistedEqualityKernel σ u y u z = 0 := by
  simp [twistedEqualityKernel, osign, ltIndicator]

theorem twistedEqualityKernel_of_symm_eq (σ : Equiv.Perm L)
    (hσ : σ.symm = σ) (u : ℝ) (y : L) (v : ℝ) (z : L) :
    twistedEqualityKernel σ u y v z =
      osign u v * (eqIndicator y z - eqIndicator y (σ z)) := by
  simp only [twistedEqualityKernel, hσ, osign_eq_indicator_sub]
  ring

omit [DecidableEq L] in
theorem perm_symm_eq_of_involutive (σ : Equiv.Perm L)
    (hσ : Function.Involutive σ) : σ.symm = σ := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro y
  calc
    σ.symm y = σ.symm (σ (σ y)) := congrArg σ.symm (hσ y).symm
    _ = σ y := σ.symm_apply_apply (σ y)

theorem twistedEqualityKernel_of_involutive (σ : Equiv.Perm L)
    (hσ : Function.Involutive σ) (u : ℝ) (y : L) (v : ℝ) (z : L) :
    twistedEqualityKernel σ u y v z =
      osign u v * (eqIndicator y z - eqIndicator y (σ z)) := by
  exact twistedEqualityKernel_of_symm_eq σ (perm_symm_eq_of_involutive σ hσ) u y v z

end TimeKernel

end TerminalOrderKernel

claims.natural_statement: For either terminal kernel, every positive even integer k, any k vectors X_i, W>=0 and Q_ij=<X_i,T X_j> satisfy |Pf(W Q)| <= (36m W)^(k/2) (product_i ||X_i||)/sqrt(k!). If n,beta>0 and a,l_i>=0 with ||X_i||<=a l_i sqrt(n/beta), the bound is at most (sqrt(108m) a sqrt(W/beta))^k (n/k)^(k/2) product_i l_i. For m<=1 the leading constant may be replaced by 11. Dependent vector families give zero; the empty Pfaffian is separately one.

The October connection regularity, face and cyclic compatibility, telescoping positivity, uniform coefficient control and Fisher estimates in co:connection remain separate unverified obligations, not consequences of the terminal singular-value theorem.

October intermediate Hilbert-Schmidt bounds, raw-stage nearby-coordinate occupancy bounds, normalized-curvature expansion and scale assembly required for pf:bound remain unverified; none follows merely from pf:terminal-singular or pf:terminal.
